preservation_rules: Do not delete or rewrite historical/negative results, AI contribution disclosures, T150 missing-items/unclosed issues or T159 GitHub audit.
Exclude only reproducible compiler/cache/duplicate/export material from Git; preserve local originals.
Before excluding any duplicate or generated tree, retain its canonical input, runner, result summary and source/hash map.
Agent-work evidence retains INTERNAL_DEVELOPMENT/DRAFT/NOT_FROZEN origin unless independent acceptance already exists; uploading is not human acceptance.
New docs Markdown requires docs/README registration and status/owner metadata; record authorship accurately.
Candidate lists do not assert all files have passed publication or tests.
gitignore_rule_notes: No .gitignore edits were made by this agent.
Patterns beginning / are repository-root anchored; * below concrete render directories covers image suffixes only, leaving audit JSON and text visible.
Ignoring /agent-work/ leaves its already tracked files tracked. Preserve research evidence mirrored in canonical docs, including all negative probes and unresolved T150 findings.
Do not replace image-only render rules with whole docs audit-directory ignores.
scope_note: The full local inventory is not published; only canonical docs and source are synchronized. No agent-work deletion. Existing tracked records remain public.

canonical_docs_secret_review.scope: Retained canonical docs small textual files only. Full preliminary scan remains in secret_scan for provenance; its agent-work hits do not imply publication scope.

findings.recommended_action: Preserve original locally with SHA; publish explicitly labeled token-redacted derivative while retaining all failure counts and error descriptions.

limitations: Pattern/context scan cannot prove absence of all secrets.
